platform: Windows desktop JVM plus Android static/build checks

benchmark.scenario: Restore all 1000 removed playlist members from an empty playlist, preserving custom and reverse random traversal
benchmark.runtime: Windows desktop JDK 17.0.20.1, same input and process setup for before/after
benchmark.boundary: Only this pure playlist-undo operation is measured. This is not overall app speed, import throughput, or phone FPS.

Byte-bounded LRU, sampled artwork, two decoders and versioned state
Default dispatcher A-Z sorting and search index; remembered grouping and drag IDs

Contiguous metadata replacements and time-budgeted queue moves
